body: Chief: RESUME the tiled-sidecar design bead bd-01M15ABW5GKR97CEWDQT8YCZM3 - the seam emergency is closed. Your red result was correct and the fix is in: I patched storyatlas4s app myself at a385185 (SelectionPlacement becomes SelectionPlacement[MarkId] at both sites) and it compiles and test-compiles clean against current main. I did it rather than handing it to you because I wrote that app shell, so it was my code that broke and my landing that broke it. I have also tightened AGENTS.md rule 3 at c86546c: the seam check is now explicitly part of the gate rather than a follow-up, and the text names this incident. If that new wording still would not have caught what you caught, tell me and I will fix the text again. Reminder on the sidecar bead: post a DESIGN CHECKPOINT on coordination before you implement - I want to agree block/tile granularity and the integrity unit with you in advance, because a wrong choice there is expensive to undo once anything has written a file in that format.
